messages:
zoe-sales: Live POC with IntegraBank showing 503 CapacityThrottle during demo. Can support ASAP? :grimacing:
kai-support: Joining. Which endpoint/model and are they streaming?
zoe-sales: /v1/chat, model=redwood-2-xl, around 25 concurrent demo tabs, not streaming.
anil-eng: Any error payload?
zoe-sales: {"status":503,"error":"CapacityThrottle","meta":"backlog=29 queue_ms=1800 autoscale=delayed"}
sara-sre: That indicates autoscaler cold-start delay. No 429s?
zoe-sales: No 429s reported.
anil-eng: Short term options: (A) allocate +2 burst nodes to tenant, (B) enable compat-quant fallback when backlog>15, (C) ask client to cap concurrency to ~8.
kai-support: I'll recommend cap + exponential backoff (start 150ms, jitter).
ops-bot: action=allocate-burstpool tenant=integraBank nodes=2 initiated_by=anil-eng at 1951122398
anil-eng: Allocation applied. backlog 29 -> 5, 503s stopped. Tail latency increased ~90ms.
zoe-sales: They resumed the demo. Sales asked about demo credits and Private deployment options for POCs. Who owns pricing/security answers?
kai-support: Sales to handle demo credits; finance to estimate. @sec-bot please prepare security questionnaire snippets.
sec-bot: Noted. Hosted environment is SOC2-compliant with TLS; Private/Dedicated options available. Drafting answers and will DM required artifacts.
anil-eng: Follow-ups created: SR-8124 (autoscaler cold-start timings), INF-4190 (cloud provisioning jitter). We should consider lowering fallback trigger to backlog>12 for high-SLA POCs.
zoe-sales: Thanks team — please add a short note I can send to the customer and a cost estimate for the 30-min demo burst. :thumbsup:
